name: modwright
description: Mod any PC game safely: identify engine and runtime, stop at anti-cheat, back up saves with hashes before touching anything, decompile before naming a patch target, pick the loader (BepInEx, MelonLoader, UE4SS, Harmony), prove the mod loaded from the loader log, prepare Workshop/Thunderstore uploads without sending them. mw.py scan, backup, restore, proof, publish-prep.
